instructions: This package is the core psychometrics and assessment calculation engine for CREED OS. Mathematical accuracy, deterministic reproducibility, and strict boundary validation are critical. Under no circumstances should unconstrained ML/LLM models compute scores or estimates.

rules.rule: Validate 3PL IRT item parameter bounds strictly: Discrimination 'a' in [0.2, 3.0], Difficulty 'b' in [-3.5, 3.5], Pseudo-guessing 'c' in [0.0, 0.35]. Out-of-bounds parameters must be rejected.
Ability estimation (theta) must use Expected A Posteriori (EAP) numerical quadrature with at least 41 integration nodes spanning [-4.0, 4.0] and standard normal prior N(0, 1).
CAT next-item selection must be completely deterministic: maximize Fisher Test Information at current theta estimate, subject to exposure control constraints.
Adaptive test termination must enforce dual stopping rules: standard error target (SE < 0.33) OR maximum item ceiling (e.g. 30 items). Never allow infinite question loops.
